outcome: Prevalence of Turner syndrome in pregnancies
Obstetric outcomes related to Turner syndrome
cohort: 17,865,495 hospital deliveries in the United States from 2016-2020
finding: Pregnant patients with Turner syndrome had an increased risk of various adverse obstetric outcomes, including intrauterine fetal demise and periviable delivery.
mod_finding: Pregnant patients with Turner syndrome were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery (41.6% vs. 32.3%; aOR 1.53; 95% CI 1.26-1.87).
